name: wheelsets
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 由车轴与左右车轮组成的车辆走行部件。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道动力学模型中，轮对可作为刚体部件，通过轮轨接触向轨道传递作用力，用于描述车辆与轨道之间的动力相互作用。

complete_examples.text: The vehicle model is considered as a multi-rigid-body system with one car body, two bogie frames and four wheelsets that are connected by two-stage suspension systems.

The vehicle is modeled as a multirigid-body system consisting of a car body, two bogie frames, and four wheelsets, and the track is modeled by finite elements including the rail, the sleeper, and the track bed.
The vehicle is modeled as a multirigid-body system, including a car body, two bogie frames, and four wheelsets.
